articles.title: US stocks: Tech selloff weighs down Wall Street as bond yields climb
articles.excerpt:
Wall Street faced a downturn as escalating tensions in the Middle East triggered a surge in bond yields. A steep decline was particularly evident in technology stocks, with semiconductors taking the brunt of the losses. Investors pivoted from growth-focused sectors to safer bets like healthcare. Additionally, oil prices rose amidst geopolitical instability and changes in military strategies.

articles.title: Lenskart shares gain over 5% to record high after incorporating new step-down subsidiary in China
articles.excerpt:

In a regulatory filing, the company said Wenzhou Framekart Trade Co., Ltd. was incorporated on August 14, 2026, as a subsidiary of Baofeng Framekart Technology Limited (BFT), a joint venture of Lenskart Solutions.

articles.title: Sunshine Pictures IPO sees strong retail demand on Day 1
articles.excerpt:
The initial public offering of Sunshine Pictures Ltd. closed its first day on Tuesday with an overall subscription of 4.33 times, driven primarily by retail and non-institutional investors, while qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) remained largely on the sidelines.

As of close on August 18, the IPO received bids for 2,37,74,711 shares against 54,86,051 shares on offer. The retail individual investor (RII) category was subscribed 5.98 times, with bids for 1,64,07,216 shares against 27,43,023 on offer. The non-institutional investor (NII) segment saw the strongest response, subscribing 6.23 times overall, with the sub-₹10 lakh category clocking 9.34 times subscription.

articles.title: Klarna trims full-year revenue, volume outlook as German retail weakens
articles.excerpt:
Klarna has adjusted its full-year volume and revenue forecasts downwards, citing difficulties in the German market. This decision resulted in a notable decrease in the company's shares during premarket trading. Nonetheless, a surprising profit in the second quarter was reported, buoyed by growth in the U.S. market, which helped mitigate some of the adverse effects of the forecast.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Citadel Securities warns SEC rule change could hurt retail investors, market liquidity
articles.excerpt:
Citadel Securities has urged the SEC to reconsider its proposal to eliminate the order protection rule, warning it could weaken market liquidity, price discovery and retail investor protections. The market maker argues the change may divert trades from public exchanges and recommends alternatives, including minimum trading-volume thresholds for exchanges to qualify for protected status.

articles.title: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures down up to 1% amid surging oil and bond yields
articles.excerpt:
US stock futures indicate a negative start to Tuesday’s trade, as technology stocks retreat from recent highs amid surging bond yields and higher oil prices, reinforcing inflation concerns.

The S&P 500 was headed for a third straight day of losses as index futures retreated 0.4%, while Nasdaq-100 futures and Dow Jones Industrial Average futures were down 1.1% and 0.1%, respectively.

The losses extended Monday’s declines as oil prices accelerated higher and bond yields jumped to trade near multidecade highs. Among key individual stocks, Nvidia Corp dropped 1.9% as the cost of protecting its debt against default approached a high reached last month.

articles.title: Voltas shares fall 4% as brokerages differ after Q1 results
articles.excerpt:
Voltas reported a 51.3 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to ₹212.76 crore in the first quarter of the current fiscal. | Photo Credit: REUTERS

Voltas shares reversed early gains and settled 4 per cent lower on Monday after brokerages gave mixed reactions to the company’s Q1FY27 results.

The stock ended 4.06 per cent lower at ₹1,267 on the NSE after moderating between ₹1,256.10-₹1,350 compared to the previous close of ₹1,320.50.

Voltas reported a 51.3 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to ₹212.76 crore in the first quarter of the current fiscal, led by a strong performance in the room air conditioners segment.

The company said it has increased market share and margins
